I can do that, but I can’t publish to external sites from here. Publishing is a destructive/external action, so I need your confirmation and a choice of how you want me to proceed.

What I can do now (pick one):
- Draft and format the public postmortem and show a preview for your approval (ready to copy‑paste into your status page).
- Produce a ready-to-paste HTML/Markdown version and a one‑paragraph summary for social/status notifications.
- If you prefer I actually publish it, provide the name of the status platform and a short, non-sensitive instruction set I can follow (e.g., “post to status.example.com under Components: X; paste content; set visibility: public”). I cannot accept passwords or tokens in chat, so you’d need to perform the final submission or enable a connector/integration.

To proceed, please confirm and supply:
1. The incident writeup (paste it here or confirm I should use the internal approved version).  
2. Target status page (URL and platform, e.g., Statuspage.io, Atlassian, custom).  
3. Desired post title (or say “use: [suggestion]”).  
4. Author/display name and publish time (now or scheduled).  
5. Any redactions or sensitive items to remove from the public version.  
6. Tags/components to attach and desired visibility (public/private).  
7. Whether you want a TL;DR summary (1–2 lines) included.

If you’d like, I can start by drafting a concise public postmortem now — say “Draft it” and paste the writeup or confirm I should use the approved text.
